name: Factory floor
description: Machines and cells from the Material flow layout, read live (MTConnect; OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, BACnet through CadCraft Studio) or from a seeded simulator. Operator screen over the layout, a job queue to Studio's Send to a machine, history and simple OEE. Reading first: writing is off unless switched on per device and confirmed. Not a safety system.
author: CadCraft
